problemStatement.formal: For every graph G with chromatic number aleph_1, does there exist an aleph_1-edge-coloring such that every proper countable vertex coloring has a vertex color class seeing all edge colors?
problemStatement.plain: Given a graph of chromatic number aleph_1, can its edges be colored with aleph_1 colors so that any proper countable vertex coloring has some vertex color class meeting every edge color?
